title_sq: SHITET SUPER APARTAMENT 3+1+2 PRANE KOPSHTIT ZOOLOGJIK
description_sq:
Apartamenti ndodhet ne zonen e Kopshtit Zoologjik ne nje zone shume te qete dhe me pak ndertime. Zona ne te cilen ndodhet te ofron dalje te shpejte ne autostraden Tirane - Elbasan dhe Tirane - Durres.
Eshte i organizuar ne:
1 sallon ndenje
1 kuzhine gatimi
3 dhoma gjumi
2 tualete
1 lavanteri
3 ballkone
Apartamenti eshte i mobiluar ne cdo detaj. I pajisur me parket druri, kondicionim qendror tavanor, dritare e dyer triplex qe ndalojne cdo lloj zhurme te interferoje ne apartament, tualetet te pajisura me ngrohje ne dysheme. Njeri prej tualeteve dhe lavanteria jane te pajisur me dritare. Dhoma matrimoniale ka nje hapesire me vete per garderobe dhe tualet te brendshem i cili arrihet nepermjet nje korridori te brendshem te dhomes.
Apartamenti eshte shtepia ideale per cdo familje ku secili pjesetar i saj ka hapesirat e veta.
Apartamenti ka edhe nje garazh te mbyllur me dy vende parkimi me cmim ekstra ne katin -1.
Nese po kerkon shtepine ideale, eja ta vizitosh nga afer kete mundesi.
title_en: SUPER APARTMENT FOR SALE 3+1+2 NEAR THE ZOO
description_en: The apartment is located in the area of ​​the Zoo in a very quiet area with few buildings. The area in which it is located offers quick access to the Tirana - Elbasan and Tirana - Durres highways. It is organized in: 1 living room, 1 kitchen, 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, 1 laundry room, 3 balconies. The apartment is furnished in every detail. Equipped with wooden floors, central ceiling air conditioning, windows and triplex doors that prevent any kind of noise from interfering in the apartment, toilets equipped with floor heating. One of the toilets and the laundry are equipped with windows. The matrimonial room has its own space for wardrobe and internal toilet, which is reached through an internal corridor of the room. The apartment is the ideal home for every family where each member has their own space. The apartment also has a closed garage with two parking spaces at an extra cost on the -1st floor. If you are looking for the ideal home, come and visit this opportunity.
